result.description:
The Client 

Blaze Engineering and Sheetmetal Fabrication Pty Ltd is a metal fabrication and engineering business based in Tullamarine, VIC, specialising in sheet metal fabrication, welding, metal assembly, and engineered manufacturing solutions.  

They are seeking an experienced Welder (First Class) to join their team in Tullamarine, VIC. 

 

The Role 

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for fabricating, assembling, and repairing metal components and structures using a range of welding and fabrication techniques. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $78,000 to $82,000 plus superannuation. 

 

The Responsibilities 

Select and prepare appropriate welding equipment, consumables, and materials for welding operations. 

Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, welding procedures, and specifications to determine welding requirements. 

Mark out and cut metal sections and components using metal-cutting machinery. 

Shape and bend metal sections and plates using machine tools. 

Set up and operate MIG welding equipment to weld, join, and repair metal components and structures. 

Position and secure workpieces to ensure accurate alignment and welding in accordance with specifications. 

Perform welding operations on various metal components while maintaining required quality and safety standards. 

Inspect completed welds to ensure compliance with specified dimensions, quality requirements, and welding standards. 

Repair defective welds and damaged metal components through grinding, gouging, and rewelding processes. 

Perform weld finishing activities, including grinding and dressing welds to achieve the required finish and appearance. 

Use measuring and testing instruments to verify weld quality, accuracy, and compliance with specifications. 

Carry out welding repairs and maintenance on metal structures, machinery, equipment, and related components. 

Clean and prepare metal surfaces before and after welding to ensure quality. 

Conduct routine maintenance and basic troubleshooting of welding equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation. 

Follow workplace health and safety procedures, welding safety requirements, and relevant industry regulations at all times. 

Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other trades personnel to complete welding tasks efficiently. 

Maintain accurate records of welding activities, inspections, repairs, materials used, and work completed. 

 

The Requirements 

Certificate IV in Engineering or equivalent qualification 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience as a Welder (First Class) or within metal fabrication environments 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience performing MIG welding across structural steel and fabricated metal components 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience interpreting engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications 

At least 1.5 years’ experience operating fabrication machinery, welding equipment, and metalworking tools 

At least 1.5 years’ experience assembling, repairing, and finishing fabricated metal products to engineering standards 

Sound knowledge of a range of welding techniques, including TIG, flux-cored and manual metal arc welding, and their application in metal fabrication. 

Strong knowledge of welding procedures, fabrication methods, and metal finishing techniques 

Ability to identify welding defects, dimensional inconsistencies, and fabrication issues accurately 

Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, fabrication compliance standards, and workshop operations 

Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within fabrication and engineering teams 

High attention to detail and commitment to precision workmanship

This role is responsible for fabricating, welding, and repairing metal components for agricultural machinery while ensuring high standards of workmanship, quality, precision, and workplace safety.

Job Description

• Fabricate and weld various components for agricultural machines.

• Follow engineering drawings and specifications precisely to ensure the accurate assembly of parts.

• Operate a range of welding equipment to join metal parts and structures effectively.

• Interpret complex engineering drawings and blueprints to determine the layout and assembly of fabricated parts.

• Perform thorough quality inspections of fabricated parts to identify defects, imperfections, or irregularities.

• Adhere to workplace health and safety procedures and safe operating practices to minimise workplace hazards and risks.

• Proficient in operating welding equipment and fabrication tools safely and efficiently.

• Strong understanding of welding techniques, fabrication processes, and quality assurance standards.

• High attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.

• Sound knowledge of workplace health and safety procedures within a manufacturing or fabrication environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify defects and recommend practical solutions.

• Reliable, safety-conscious, and committed to maintaining high standards of workmanship and continuous improvement.

$76,515 - $80,000

Job summary
From humble beginnings in 1990 from a small country Bakery, to 36 years later, known in the region for our quality artisan products, cafe menu and the best beverages in town.
Open six days from 6 am, as a part-time member of our beverage crew, your schedule will include 5 days plus an alternate Saturday.
We pride ourselves on quality and consistency. Experience with running a fast-paced beverage bar, including cold beverages, is necessary.

Responsibilities and duties
•	Monitor the cleanliness of equipment and the operation of premises throughout your day.
•	Compliance with occupational health and safety regulations
•	Check the quality of raw materials and weigh ingredients.
•	Brew, dose, and prepare espresso coffees to the highest quality, following in-house recipes, quality & consistency expectations.
•	Preparing other beverages, including tea and hot chocolate.
•	Prepare and serve our menu of cold beverages as per recipe cards, ensuring quality and consistency with every beverage.
•	Coordinate the daily workflow of the Beverage Station following in-house routine, systems & processes.
•	Operate machines which dose, tamp & brew espresso coffee.
•	Run morning season routine & opening of business.
•	Checking customer orders and delivery details.
•	Ensure the highest possible beverage quality according to the health and safety regulations.
•	Quality control awareness on ordering and wastage.
•	Completion & participation in the daily running of Font of House and the Beverage Bar duties by following the Morning, End of Day and Prep process and systems.
•	Competency in Open & closing of business.
•	Welcoming customers, taking their orders, and handling payments.
•	Restock & ordering of Beverage Bar items. 

Why work for us?
We serve up the best beverages in town from 6 am, and we are home by 3 pm; that alone is a Hospo Bonus! 
We have a strong focus on Culture, Quality and Consistency, and our team is number one to us. We have a friendly and professional environment and love some good banter. We gather the crew throughout the year for a bowls day and end with our Christmas party. We love what we do, and we hope you do too! 

Qualifications
Qualifications are not necessary. Skills and experience are required. 

The position requires a minimum of two years’ experience.

result.description:
A Developer Programmer plays a pivotal role in the software development lifecycle, encompassing the design, development, installation, and testing of software applications.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, code, test, and debug software applications to meet specific requirements. This involves writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code across various programming languages.
Analyze existing systems to identify areas for modification or improvement, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including user manuals and technical specifications, to support software deployment and maintenance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including designers, analysts, and other developers, to deliver cohesive software solutions.
Identify, diagnose, and resolve software defects and issues to maintain system integrity and performance.

Essential Skills and Qualifications:
A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
Minimum 2+ years of experience in Software Development.
Must have experience in both Backend and Frontend development
Expertise in programming languages HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Strong problem-solving skills to analyze complex requirements and develop effective software solutions.
Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working in collaborative environments, utilizing methodologies like Agile or Scrum to enhance team productivity
